claims.claim: The Childcare Grant application requires childcare provider registration details.
claims.quote: your childcare provider is on the Ofsted Early Years Register or General Childcare Register - check with your provider
claims.note: Provider registration is an eligibility condition, but the supplied text does not say registration details are required as application evidence.

claims.claim: The Childcare Grant application requires childcare cost receipts.
claims.quote: Use your online account to invoice childcare costs throughout the academic year.
claims.note: The provider invoices costs after award through the payment service; childcare receipts for the grant application are not stated.

claims.claim: The Childcare Grant application requires household income evidence.
claims.quote: Student Finance England will ask the people in your household to confirm their income . They might need to provide evidence.
claims.note: Household income must be provided, but documentary evidence may be needed rather than always required.
